name: GRC Librarian
description: Read-only librarian over the GRC corpus. Answers control, framework, and POA&M questions by searching docs/grc/. Low sensitivity because the corpus is sanitized and the agent has no write paths.

skills.name: GRC Search
skills.description: Searches the GRC corpus for documents matching a control id, family, or natural language query.

skills.name: GRC Read
skills.description: Returns the body of a named GRC document by path under docs/grc/.

skills.name: Framework Lookup
skills.description: Resolves NIST 800-53 controls, family codes, and FedRAMP baselines against the crosswalk.
